title: Planning and writing for a reader

steps.say: Before you write, decide your purpose and your reader.
steps.show: purpose: to persuade     reader: the head teacher

steps.say: Choose the right type of text and use its features.
Plan your main points in order before you start.
Use paragraphs, with one main idea in each.
Read your work again. Check that it makes sense, then fix spelling and punctuation.

check.prompt: You want to tell readers how a volcano erupts. Which type of text should you write?

options.why: A poem shares feelings and pictures more than facts.
A persuasive letter tries to change someone’s mind.
A diary records your own day and feelings.

hints: Think about your purpose: telling how something happens.
Each type of text has a different job.
Find the text type that explains how or why things happen.
check.explanation: An explanation tells the reader how or why something happens, so it is the right choice.
